ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with localized high-intensity (white) markings. Macro-level intensity ratio is approximately 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous clusters (barnacles) concentrated at the distal lateral tips and along the outer trailing edges. Numerous high-intensity annular rings (circular scars) are distributed across the dark interior surfaces of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a calculated pixel-vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth profile along the posterior boundary; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from approximately 5 to 22 pixels with approximately 18 distinct peaks visible per lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a bilateral convex sweep from the medial notch toward the lateral tips, following a broadly parabolic curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed spatial pattern of high-intensity annular rings (circles and ovals) of varying diameters scattered across both the left and right ventral lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Isolated, faint high-intensity linear streaks visible, including a nearly horizontal disruption on the lower portion of the left lobe and diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of high-intensity calcified structures (barnacles) at the lateral tips and outer trailing edges; widespread circular depigmentation scars consistent with parasitic attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive and dense population of 'O'-shaped annular scarring throughout the ventral surface providing a unique spatial fingerprint.
